entry.title: Why pytest.raises match can accept the wrong error message
entry.summary: A regular-expression search can accept extra text, wildcard characters, or exception notes. Define accepted and rejected errors first.

entry.title: Both canary and control got worse: why can a zero difference still block rollout?
entry.summary: A zero canary-control gap can hide shared harm; compare eligible requests, absolute user impact, and critical-path coverage before expansion.

entry.title: WCAG 2.5.8: Check the Active Target Before Applying the Spacing Exception
entry.summary: Measure the active area, check every nearby target, and document the exact WCAG 2.5.8 exception that applies.

entry.title: 按钮写“提交”，用户究竟答应了什么？
entry.summary: 按钮标签要对应保存、送审或付款的真实动作；把点击后的状态、失败反馈与必要条件一起纳入需求评审。

entry.title: CSP 的默认加载规则能限制表单提交地址吗
entry.summary: form-action 不回退到 default-src；按真实表单目的地检查允许范围，并单独验证重定向与业务结果。

entry.title: 给组件宽度一个可验收的尺寸口径
entry.summary: 内容宽度与边框外沿采用不同计算口径；先确认盒模型，再排查外边距、长内容和布局约束。

entry.title: 折叠详情适合补充解释，不适合藏住行动条件
entry.summary: 以用户决策所需的信息区分主内容与补充帮助；清楚的展开入口不能替代默认可见的重要条件。

entry.title: Docker 构建命中缓存，软件包索引为什么可能已过时
entry.summary: RUN 缓存不会自动因时间失效；同层更新与安装修正局部失配，刷新时机与实际依赖版本仍需明确。

entry.title: 两个 worktree 的文件独立，Git 引用和 stash 也独立吗
entry.summary: worktree 的 HEAD 和暂存区分开，常见分支与 stash 引用共享；恢复前应核对记录内容和任务归属。

entry.title: 没查到记录，就能返回 410 吗？
entry.summary: 404 不判断缺失是否永久；410 需要源站对长期不可用有依据，响应、权限披露与缓存策略还需分别核对。

entry.title: Array.fill 放入对象，为什么改一项会影响其他项
entry.summary: fill 重复的是同一个对象引用；独立可编辑行需要各自构造对象，并检查嵌套状态和断言预期。

entry.title: Object.freeze 后，嵌套配置为什么仍会变化？
entry.summary: 浅冻结限制当前对象自身的属性；嵌套对象、共享引用和访问器仍需明确边界，再决定是否采用递归处理。

entry.title: 容器已经 Ready，Pod 为什么还在等待自定义就绪条件
entry.summary: readinessGates 要求所有列出的条件为 True；缺失按 False 处理，容器就绪之外还要确认状态写入责任。

entry.title: 直方图声明了单位，为什么还要检查实际记录值？
entry.summary: 单位元数据不能证明数值已换算；记录值、分桶、阈值及历史查询需要采用一致的测量契约。

entry.title: 允许 camera 权限政策，为什么页面仍不能使用摄像头
entry.summary: camera 政策允许来源，仍要满足安全上下文、用户许可与设备条件；错误名称和等待状态需要分别处理。

entry.title: route.continue 透传请求，也不等于还原缓存环境
entry.summary: 启用 Playwright 网络路由会禁用 HTTP 缓存；缓存验收应单独保留无路由环境并记录请求层次。

entry.title: 列有 DEFAULT，为什么显式写入 NULL 仍没有默认值
entry.summary: 默认值处理省略与显式请求默认值的情况；接口应保留缺省、清空和具体取值之间的差别。

entry.title: LEFT JOIN 的条件移到 WHERE，为什么未匹配行消失了
entry.summary: 区分联接匹配与结果过滤，用三类客户样本确定哪些行应该保留，并检查多明细造成的重复。

entry.title: 时间倒序后，为什么没有时间的记录排在最前？
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 降序默认把空值放在前面；将空值位置、多列方向和同值顺序写进查询，并先确认空值的业务含义。

entry.title: 整数计数器为什么算出了小数 increase
entry.summary: increase 的窗口外推可能给整数计数器算出小数；重置处理、聚合顺序与对账用途需要分别理解。

entry.title: 同时设置两种容差，不表示两道门都要通过
entry.summary: pytest.approx 的相对与绝对容差采用或条件；先写清参考值、单位和业务误差预算，再选择参数。

entry.title: 系统过载时，为什么拒绝部分请求可能比全部排队更可靠？
entry.summary: 过长排队消耗资源并增加无效工作；拒绝和降级也需成本、优先级、客户端反馈与恢复验收。

entry.title: Blob URL 能打开文件，为什么不代表已经保存？
entry.summary: 临时对象地址、预览、文件保存与释放各有生命周期；明确使用者和清理责任，再验证用户实际得到的产物。

entry.title: What does a “Submit” button ask the user to confirm?
entry.summary: Match button labels to saving, review and payment, then check the resulting state and failure feedback.

entry.title: Does default-src restrict where a form submits?
entry.summary: CSP form destinations need their own directive. Check allowed targets, browser redirect behavior, and business outcomes separately.

entry.title: Give component width a measurable box-model contract
entry.summary: Define whether width means content or the border edge before diagnosing padding, margins and layout overflow.

entry.title: Use collapsed details for help, keep action conditions visible
entry.summary: Separate supplementary help from information users need before deciding, and make disclosure controls descriptive.

entry.title: Why a cached Docker build can use an old package index
entry.summary: Package freshness needs an explicit cache decision and installed-version evidence. Combining update and installation fixes a narrower mismatch.

entry.title: Do separate Git worktrees have separate references and stashes?
entry.summary: Worktrees keep separate HEADs and indexes while sharing ordinary references and stashes. Verify record ownership before restoring unfinished work.

entry.title: Does an empty lookup justify HTTP 410?
entry.summary: Distinguish missing resources from traceable retirement decisions, with separate checks for disclosure and caching.

entry.title: Why Array.fill makes several rows share one editable object
entry.summary: Repeated object references are shared state; construct independent editable rows and verify nested data and saved identities.

entry.title: Why can nested settings change after Object.freeze?
entry.summary: Shallow freezing protects the outer object; nested references, accessors and recursive handling need explicit boundaries.

entry.title: Why ready containers can leave a Pod waiting for a readiness gate
entry.summary: Custom readiness gates need every listed condition True; missing conditions count as False. Assign status ownership beyond container probes.

entry.title: Check histogram values against their declared unit
entry.summary: Check measurement values, histogram boundaries and downstream thresholds against one unit contract.

entry.title: Why an allowed camera policy does not make a camera usable
entry.summary: Camera policy, secure context, user consent, and device availability are separate checks. Test waiting and denial paths as well as success.

entry.title: Passing requests through route.continue does not preserve the cache environment
entry.summary: Playwright routing disables HTTP caching, so browser-cache acceptance needs its own controlled environment and evidence.

entry.title: Why an explicit NULL does not use a PostgreSQL column default
entry.summary: Keep omission, explicit clearing and supplied values distinct so database defaults receive the intended input.

entry.title: Why moving a LEFT JOIN condition into WHERE removes unmatched rows
entry.summary: Separate join matching from result filtering, then verify customer identities and detail counts against the intended report.

entry.title: Why does descending time order put missing timestamps first?
entry.summary: Specify null placement, individual column directions and tie handling in PostgreSQL lists, after defining what missing values mean.

entry.title: Why Prometheus increase can be fractional for integer counters
entry.summary: Prometheus extrapolates counter increases over a query window. Interpret fractions, resets, and display precision against that measurement scope.

entry.title: Two pytest.approx tolerances are alternatives, not two mandatory gates
entry.summary: Choose a reference value, unit and error budget before approving the relative and absolute tolerance settings.

entry.title: Bound admission and degradation during service overload
entry.summary: Bound queueing and rejection while verifying useful outcomes, client feedback and recovery.

entry.title: An accessible Blob URL does not prove a saved file
entry.summary: Separate temporary object addresses, previews, file saving and cleanup, then verify the artifact users actually receive.

entry.title: 成功页面显示完成后，用户为什么仍不知道下一步？
entry.summary: 确认页说明已完成的提交、下一步、时间与查询方式；返回页面和通知状态也应有可靠含义。

entry.title: CSP 禁止加载 iframe，就能阻止本站被别人嵌入吗？
entry.summary: frame-ancestors 控制谁可嵌入当前页；不回退到 default-src，不支持 meta，嵌套祖先需逐层核对。

entry.title: Docker 发布端口后，为什么其他机器也能访问？
entry.summary: 发布端口需核对绑定、地址族、路由和版本；保留 28.0.0 前 localhost 发布的二层网络例外。

entry.title: 表单只显示有错误，用户怎样找到需要修改的答案？
entry.summary: 错误摘要应关联具体答案、协调焦点和字段旁文案，保留正确输入并验证实际纠错路径。

entry.title: git stash 后文件还在，哪些内容没有被暂存？
entry.summary: stash 的跟踪、未跟踪和忽略范围不同；清理前核对条目，恢复时保留索引与冲突证据。

entry.title: 输入框禁用了，提交时为什么收不到原来的值？
entry.summary: 禁用控件不参与原生表单提交；核对脚本序列化、动态依赖与服务端可信来源，不把显示值当请求证据。

entry.title: 收到 HTTP 405，应该修改方法还是检查目标资源？
entry.summary: 405 表示目标资源不支持该方法；结合 Allow、实际路由和入口排查，资源能力不等于用户权限。

entry.title: 事故级别应该看告警数量，还是看实际用户影响？
entry.summary: 事故级别结合用户影响与响应动作；明确不确定时的升级、复核和协调责任，不照搬组织编号。

entry.title: 日期字符串没写时区，为什么两种写法解析结果不同？
entry.summary: 标准纯日期与无时区日期时间采用不同解释；区分日历日、瞬间和当地安排，避免局部偏移修补。

entry.title: 对象里有 undefined，JSON 请求为什么少了字段？
entry.summary: 默认 JSON 序列化对对象和数组中的 undefined 处理不同；缺失、null 与清空应有明确接口语义。

entry.title: Service 的 port 改了，为什么流量没到应用监听端口？
entry.summary: Service 入口与目标端口不同；核对名称解析、选择器和实际监听，并验证新旧 Pod 的运行契约。

entry.title: 环境变量写了 false，功能为什么仍然开启？
entry.summary: Node 环境值是字符串；明确布尔允许值、缺失和无效策略，在统一边界解析而非依赖真值判断。

entry.title: 一个批次来自多条链路，Span 应该选谁当父级？
entry.summary: 多来源批次用真实操作边界表达关系；链接创建时机可能影响采样，关联不保证目标 Span 可见。

entry.title: Playwright 下载事件触发了，为什么产物仍然丢失？
entry.summary: 下载事件、文件保存和内容验收是不同阶段；等待持久保存并核对上下文关闭、并行隔离与失败证据。

entry.title: COUNT(*) 和 COUNT(字段) 为什么给出不同数量？
entry.summary: COUNT 的行数与非空输入口径不同；先检查过滤、连接基数和指标单位，再讨论数量与性能。

entry.title: UNION 合并报表后，为什么记录数量变少了？
entry.summary: UNION 对结果行去重，UNION ALL 保留重复；投影、业务身份、来源与顺序应分别说明。

entry.title: Prometheus 出现 exported_job，原来的标签去了哪里？
entry.summary: honor_labels 改变冲突标签的优先关系；追踪原始标签与服务器附加值，不为去掉前缀盲目切换。

entry.title: pytest 没有 INFO 日志，是没执行还是捕获级别不对？
entry.summary: INFO 日志检查需明确捕获级别；区分日志记录、终端显示和业务执行，断言稳定且可归属的信息。

entry.title: 站点用了 HTTPS，页面路径还会通过 Referer 发出去吗？
entry.summary: 来源政策按同源、跨源和降级决定发送范围；HTTPS 不替代来源信息最小化，来源头也不提供授权。

entry.title: URLSearchParams 为什么把数据里的加号变成空格？
entry.summary: 查询文本会把加号解释为空格；用原始值调用参数接口，并核对预编码、解码与迁移边界。

entry.title: Explain the next state on a confirmation page
entry.summary: Explain confirmed submission, next steps and reliable revisit paths on receipt pages.

entry.title: Separate frame loading from frame ancestor permission
entry.summary: Verify frame ancestor permission in response headers separately from child-frame loading.

entry.title: Review Docker published port bindings and reachability
entry.summary: Review Docker port exposure with binding, routing and pre-28.0.0 localhost limitations.

entry.title: Connect error summaries to the answers needing correction
entry.summary: Connect validation summaries, focus and field messages into an actionable correction path.

entry.title: Review tracked, untracked and ignored scope before stashing
entry.summary: Verify stash scope and entry identity before cleanup, task switching and restoration.

entry.title: Account for disabled controls in form submission
entry.summary: Review disabled controls, actual submission data and server-owned state independently.

entry.title: Interpret HTTP 405 through the target resource contract
entry.summary: Diagnose unsupported methods against the target resource and keep authorization separate.

entry.title: Define incident severity from observable impact
entry.summary: Define incident impact, escalation and coordination without importing another team’s severity numbers.

entry.title: Make Date.parse timezone assumptions explicit
entry.summary: Keep calendar dates and instants distinct when parsing strings with implicit timezone assumptions.

entry.title: Define missing fields before JSON serialization
entry.summary: Define missing and null fields before relying on default JSON serialization behavior.

entry.title: Verify Kubernetes Service target port resolution
entry.summary: Trace Service entry ports, named targets and actual application listeners during rollout.

entry.title: Parse environment flags as an explicit configuration type
entry.summary: Parse environment flags with explicit accepted values and invalid-input behavior.

entry.title: Represent multiple causal relationships with Span links
entry.summary: Represent multiple trace relationships with links and preserve sampling and visibility limits.

entry.title: Await and preserve Playwright downloads before context closure
entry.summary: Await download persistence and validate artifacts before closing the browser context.

entry.title: Choose a PostgreSQL count that matches the metric
entry.summary: Match PostgreSQL row and non-null counts to an explicit metric definition.

entry.title: Choose duplicate semantics before using UNION
entry.summary: Choose set-operation duplicate semantics using explicit row identity and output requirements.

entry.title: Understand Prometheus honor_labels conflicts
entry.summary: Trace conflicting scraped and server labels before changing honor_labels precedence.

entry.title: Set a deliberate log capture level in pytest
entry.summary: Set log capture levels explicitly and assert meaningful records rather than terminal appearance.

entry.title: Control referrer exposure separately from transport encryption
entry.summary: Review referrer disclosure by origin relationship and keep transport and authorization distinct.

entry.title: Preserve literal plus signs in URLSearchParams values
entry.summary: Preserve literal plus signs by separating raw values from serialized query text.

entry.title: 线上服务有人不会用，辅助渠道怎样才算完成任务？
entry.summary: 辅助渠道需回应真实障碍、保留用户知情并交接任务；客服工单关闭不能代替业务完成。

entry.title: Docker 改了默认日志驱动，旧容器为什么没变？
entry.summary: 日志默认值只影响新容器；核对实际实例配置，带数据和恢复计划安排重建并验证日志出口。

entry.title: Fetch 日志读过正文，业务解析为什么又失败？
entry.summary: 响应正文被日志消费后不能再次解析；明确消费者，在读取前决定克隆或单次解析及保留范围。

entry.title: forEach 里写了 await，外层为什么提前结束？
entry.summary: forEach 不等待异步回调；按依赖与并发预算组织任务，明确完成、错误汇总和取消责任。

entry.title: 分支推送成功，发布标签为什么还没到远程？
entry.summary: 分支推送不证明标签已到远程；区分标签选择范围、可达条件和源码到产物的发布证据。

entry.title: HTTP 204 成功后，为什么不该继续解析 JSON？
entry.summary: 204 没有响应正文，仍可能包含有用元数据；解析、界面提示和重试应依据接口契约。

entry.title: GET 请求带了筛选正文，为什么服务链路未必理解？
entry.summary: GET 正文没有通用定义的语义；源站支持不保证中间层理解，应明确查询身份与迁移契约。

entry.title: 多语言列表排序，为什么需要明确 Collator 的语言？
entry.summary: 语言与比较选项影响显示顺序；比较相等不等于记录同一，平局和分页需要独立规则。

entry.title: Kubernetes Job 重试次数，为什么不能只数失败 Pod？
entry.summary: Job 失败限制涉及失败 Pod 和特定策略下的容器重试；分清重试层并核对业务副作用。

entry.title: Map 里存过对象，换一个相同对象为什么找不到？
entry.summary: Map 对象键按引用比较；根据实例或业务身份设计键范围，并分别处理版本变化与失效。

entry.title: npm 开了 ignore-scripts，为什么仍能运行项目脚本？
entry.summary: ignore-scripts 不阻止显式目标脚本执行；安装准备、构建产物和执行权限应分阶段审查。

entry.title: OAuth 回调在同一域名下，为什么仍要精确匹配？
entry.summary: OAuth 回调需精确匹配登记 URI；保留原生应用 localhost 端口例外，并单独审查各段跳转许可。

entry.title: Span 已结束，进程退出前还需要刷新导出吗？
entry.summary: Span 结束不等于后端保存；为批量队列、刷新和关闭安排有限预算，保留导出确认的边界。

entry.title: Playwright 重试通过后，第一次失败还要保留吗？
entry.summary: 重试通过仍需保留首轮失败；关联每次尝试、worker 重建与外部副作用，明确 flaky 的发布处理。

entry.title: 空数组长度为什么是 NULL，什么时候用 cardinality？
entry.summary: array_length 检查维度，cardinality 统计总元素；空集合、未知输入和缺失维度应保留含义。

entry.title: PostgreSQL RETURNING 有结果，事务就提交了吗？
entry.summary: RETURNING 提供实际修改行，不证明显式事务提交或外部交付完成；零行和多行也需业务解释。

entry.title: Prometheus 抓取更频繁，告警为什么不一定更快？
entry.summary: 抓取与评估周期分别控制不同阶段；沿事件到通知核对实际时间，不从单个参数承诺延迟。

entry.title: pytest 没捕获到输出，应该选 capsys 还是 capfd？
entry.summary: capsys 与 capfd 观察不同输出层；快照不等待任务完成，字节、文本与日志出口需要明确。

entry.title: 重复工作都值得自动化吗？先判断它是不是 toil
entry.summary: 用 toil 特征评估重复工作，比较消除需求、工程改进和自动化，并计入失败维护负担。

entry.title: 问卷把速度和质量放在一起，答案还能解释吗？
entry.summary: 速度与质量合并评分难以解释；先拆开决策所需概念，再检查适用人群、试答理解与历史可比性。

entry.title: Design assisted digital support around task completion
entry.summary: Research support needs and preserve informed task completion across assistance channels.

entry.title: Verify logging configuration on existing Docker containers
entry.summary: Verify per-container logging settings and plan recreation with data and recovery evidence.

entry.title: Assign ownership before consuming a Fetch response body
entry.summary: Assign Fetch body ownership before reading, cloning or sharing parsed results.

entry.title: Make asynchronous iteration completion explicit
entry.summary: Define asynchronous iteration completion, concurrency and failure policy explicitly.

entry.title: Select Git tags deliberately when pushing a release
entry.summary: Select release tag scope deliberately and verify remote targets against build artifacts.

entry.title: Handle successful HTTP 204 responses without parsing a body
entry.summary: Handle no-content success explicitly and keep parsing failures separate from operation outcomes.

entry.title: Avoid assuming shared semantics for GET request content
entry.summary: Define interoperable query semantics rather than relying on private GET-body assumptions.

entry.title: Define locale-sensitive ordering without changing identity
entry.summary: Define locale-sensitive ordering, tie handling and identity as separate contracts.

entry.title: Read Job retry limits across Pods and container restarts
entry.summary: Read Job limits alongside Pod and container attempts without assuming business deduplication.

entry.title: Choose reference or logical identity for Map keys
entry.summary: Choose explicit instance or business identity, scope and invalidation for Map keys.

entry.title: Understand the boundary of npm ignore-scripts
entry.summary: Separate npm lifecycle controls, deliberate script execution and artifact completeness.

entry.title: Match OAuth redirect URIs against exact registrations
entry.summary: Constrain OAuth redirect receivers with exact registration matching and narrow exceptions.

entry.title: Budget shutdown time for batched OpenTelemetry spans
entry.summary: Budget batched Span shutdown and distinguish delivery confirmation from backend persistence.

entry.title: Keep first-failure evidence when Playwright retries pass
entry.summary: Preserve first-failure evidence and attempt identity when Playwright retries succeed.

entry.title: Distinguish array dimensions from total cardinality
entry.summary: Distinguish array dimension length, total element count and unknown business states.

entry.title: Separate RETURNING rows from transaction commit
entry.summary: Separate modified-row results, confirmed transaction commit and external delivery.

entry.title: Separate Prometheus scraping from rule evaluation
entry.summary: Trace scraping, evaluation and later notification stages before changing alert timing.

entry.title: Match pytest output capture to the writing boundary
entry.summary: Match pytest capture fixtures and snapshot timing to the actual output boundary.

entry.title: Choose automation work by toil characteristics
entry.summary: Assess toil characteristics and failure workload before selecting automation investments.

entry.title: Separate concepts in double-barreled survey questions
entry.summary: Separate survey concepts and preserve the context needed to interpret answers.

entry.title: 提交前能查看答案，为什么还需要直接修改和返回？
entry.summary: 核对页需支持直接纠错并保留任务；编辑后处理依赖问题，区分核对、修改与最终提交。

entry.title: Cookie 设置了 Path，就能隔离同站点的敏感功能吗？
entry.summary: Path 控制 Cookie 发送范围而非业务授权；同名值、迁移与注销要按实际范围及服务端会话分别核对。

entry.title: 容器已经 unhealthy，为什么没有按重启策略恢复？
entry.summary: 独立 Docker 的健康状态与退出条件不同；明确恢复执行者，并验证进行中任务与最终业务结果。

entry.title: 错误预算耗尽后，是否所有变更都应该停止？
entry.summary: 错误预算政策需范围、窗口、例外与解除条件；紧急修复仍绑定版本、责任和验证证据。

entry.title: 表单里的每个字段，谁能说明收集以后用来做什么？
entry.summary: 每个表单字段都需要用途、适用人群与维护责任；问题协议先于页面措辞，不用未来可能分析代替收集理由。

entry.title: 文件写进 gitignore，为什么改动仍然会被 Git 看到？
entry.summary: gitignore 不改变已跟踪文件；停止跟踪、清理历史与撤销秘密分开，干净检出还需初始化证据。

entry.title: 请求写了 Accept，客户端为什么仍要检查响应类型？
entry.summary: Accept 表达媒体偏好，仍需核对实际类型、状态和正文；通配范围不扩大解析能力。

entry.title: Content-Length 为什么不等于解压后的正文长度？
entry.summary: Content-Length 针对字节与表示层，编码后长度不能直接比较解压内容；进度与业务完整性需要分开。

entry.title: JSON 解析没报错，长编号为什么还是变了？
entry.summary: JSON 数字语法正确不保证长编号精确；在数值转换前保留身份，逐层核对而不从舍入值猜原文。

entry.title: 配置 Always 后，为什么仍然会复用本地镜像层？
entry.summary: Always 可复用匹配层，标签变化也不重算已有默认策略；核对摘要、真实对象与运行版本。

entry.title: 按钮透明了，为什么仍然能被点击和聚焦？
entry.summary: 透明控件仍可能接收点击与焦点；视觉、交互和恢复状态需协调，不以截图代替任务验收。

entry.title: 记录异常事件后，Span 状态为什么仍不是错误？
entry.summary: 手动埋点分别处理异常事件与操作状态；恢复结果、上下文归属和敏感内容仍需明确判断。

entry.title: 网络空闲了，测试为什么还不能直接宣布页面就绪？
entry.summary: 网络空闲不证明业务就绪；根据实际任务断言目标状态，保留错误、空结果和旧结果的区别。

entry.title: numeric 限定两位小数，为什么没有拒绝更多小数？
entry.summary: numeric 比例约束可能舍入输入；校验、保存和计算规则分别定义，不从处理后值伪造原始精度。

entry.title: 事务回滚了，序列编号为什么没有退回去？
entry.summary: 序列值不随回滚回收，空洞不等于已提交记录丢失；业务编号、统计和外部交付需独立确认。

entry.title: 记录规则有结果，原来的实例标签为什么不见了？
entry.summary: 记录规则产生新序列，表达式和配置都影响标签；逐层核对身份、窗口与下游使用契约。

entry.title: 主任务成功了，finally 为什么仍能让调用链失败？
entry.summary: finally 清理抛错或拒绝会改变调用链结果；区分主任务与清理状态，避免错误恢复重复副作用。

entry.title: 标记 xfail 的测试恢复通过，为什么流水线仍可能放行？
entry.summary: xfail 的意外通过受严格设置影响；维护原因、范围和退出条件，核对真实断言而非只看绿灯。

entry.title: 登录后返回地址，怎样避免变成任意跳转入口？
entry.summary: 返回地址需批准映射或解析后许可判断；站内路径仍需授权，校验失败应有安全落点。

entry.title: 新标签页里的 sessionStorage，为什么会带着旧值？
entry.summary: sessionStorage 可从 opener 初始复制，之后独立；重载不等于清空，草稿应关联任务与恢复条件。

entry.title: Make pre-submission review editable without restarting the journey
entry.summary: Preserve task identity and dependent answers during pre-submission correction.

entry.title: Use cookie paths for sending scope rather than authorization
entry.summary: Keep cookie sending scope separate from object authorization and session revocation.

entry.title: Distinguish container health from the restart policy trigger
entry.summary: Separate health detection, restart triggers and actual business recovery in standalone Docker.

entry.title: Define error-budget restrictions and exceptions before an incident
entry.summary: Define error-budget restrictions, exceptions and release evidence before urgent decisions.

entry.title: Require a purpose for every form question
entry.summary: Define necessity, users and maintenance ownership before adding form fields.

entry.title: Separate ignoring untracked paths from removing tracked content
entry.summary: Separate ignoring, tracking state, historical content and secret-response responsibilities.

entry.title: Verify the response beyond the requested media preference
entry.summary: Check actual response type, status and body beyond requested media preferences.

entry.title: Measure HTTP body length at the right encoding layer
entry.summary: Compare lengths only across matching units and representation layers.

entry.title: Preserve long identifiers before numeric parsing loses precision
entry.summary: Preserve exact identifiers before numeric conversion and inspect every transport boundary.

entry.title: Track image identity beyond tag names and pull-policy labels
entry.summary: Verify image digests and actual pull policy without treating cache reuse as stale deployment.

entry.title: Separate visual transparency from interaction availability
entry.summary: Coordinate transparency, interaction availability and focus instead of relying on appearance.

entry.title: Record exceptions and operation status as separate decisions
entry.summary: Classify operation status separately from exception events and verify context ownership.

entry.title: Assert task readiness instead of relying on network silence
entry.summary: Assert task-specific readiness rather than inferring completion from quiet connections.

entry.title: Separate numeric storage rounding from input validation
entry.summary: Separate numeric rounding, input acceptance and calculation policy.

entry.title: Treat sequence values as identifiers rather than gapless accounting
entry.summary: Distinguish allocated sequence values from committed records and completed business work.

entry.title: Review the label contract of a recorded metric
entry.summary: Trace recorded metric identity through expressions, label overrides and downstream consumers.

entry.title: Give cleanup failures an explicit outcome policy
entry.summary: Separate main-operation outcomes from cleanup failures and retry decisions.

entry.title: Make unexpected passes visible in expected-failure tests
entry.summary: Review XPASS behavior and exception ownership against current pytest settings.

entry.title: Validate redirect destinations as a navigation trust boundary
entry.summary: Constrain navigation destinations with approved mappings and explicit parsed-component checks.

entry.title: Understand per-tab storage without assuming a blank initial state
entry.summary: Model initial storage copying, independent tab changes and draft recovery explicitly.
